results.name: Bounded JSON: streaming byte limit, Content-Length, malformed and non-object
GeoNames guard: no owner 401, lazy adapter/secret, per-user app limit with retry seconds, window reset
GeoNames guard counts real upstream fetches and the worker-local total across owners; cache avoids refetch
Unauthenticated You/onboarding calls: 401, zero product writes, no GeoNames setup
Oversize bodies: 413 from real You/onboarding handlers with no entity call
Real guard + real adapter: app, user-upstream and worker-upstream limits keep 429/retry and stop provider fetches
Onboarding and You handlers return 429, GEONAMES_RATE_LIMITED, Retry-After and retry_after_seconds for the real chain error
Negative: network failure and a forged 429-shaped error from fetch stay GEONAMES_UNAVAILABLE, never rate-limited
